I've saved the draft mail to Marcus Lindqvist (mlindqvist@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in the DM. Nothing has been sent; someone still has to review and send the draft.

- **What it says:** the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Tansley Parcel is $1,752, as Pree gave it. It also says Anselm approved sharing it and asks Marcus to keep it internal.
- **Why it could go ahead:** a per-seat rate is a finance figure. Marcus doesn't own the Tansley Parcel account, so he can only receive it with approval from Anselm or June. Anselm is the CFO and approved it in this message. Marcus's address is at pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval for outside mail wasn't needed.
- **Not checked:** I couldn't confirm the $1,752 from anything Anselm can see. The rate isn't in any public file or in the brain, and the Tansley account folder shows no files. Pree's DM with me may be where it came from, but Anselm can't see that DM, so I didn't read it for him. The draft uses the figure exactly as Anselm stated it.
